question: Does a piece staged by symlink into the frozen corpus behave identically to one staged by copy, and does it stage no geometry of its own?

arms.A: inputs copied with cp (the old way)

parameters.pipeline: shipped defaults; no env switch set except POT_NAME and SFS_AXIS_FILE

scripts.note: the tested script is the worktree copy at commit 3888318, uncommitted; the job ran the uploaded bytes with this md5

binaries.edge: a28d10afab2b50bbe750d599ee2b7214 (copied from the p290 run's bin/, ticket 288/290 binary)

steps: record binary md5s and the script under test; md5 the six corpus inputs
per piece: stage A by cp, stage B by stage_piece.sh; pre-run census of both
per arm: mesh stage (SFS_AXIS_FILE set, classify lines quoted), then edge stage
corpus md5 re-check; cmp291.py identity + scores + provenance + census verdicts
delete both stage trees, write out/GEOMETRY_DELETED.txt

acceptance_gate.1_identity: n equal and max|dxyz| = 0.000000 between the A and B exports, else the gate fails and the ticket stops
acceptance_gate.2_no_geometry_in_B: no regular file larger than 1 MiB in the symlinked stage, exactly 2 symlinks per piece, du reported for both stages
acceptance_gate.3_provenance: every staged input resolves into the corpus and its md5 matches MANIFEST_released.tsv / MANIFEST_derived.tsv
acceptance_gate.4_scores: reported for both arms, not gated against older runs
